name: Executive Summary
description: Sponsor-facing 7-slide deck. Engine fills cover + numeric stats; AI writes the three narrative panels (headline findings, top risks, executive recommendations) so the sponsor reads curated prose, not raw bullet dumps.

sections.title: Headline findings
sections.purpose: 5–7 highest-severity findings written for an executive sponsor — not the engineering team. Each as a short markdown bullet: a strong opening clause (the issue), one or two sentences of business consequence, no domain code prefixes ([CRITICAL/security_iam] etc.) Cut the long tail; the engineering audience sees the full list elsewhere. Order by severity desc, then by likely business impact.

sections.title: Top risks
sections.purpose: 5–7 most material risks. Same audience and prose rules as headline_findings. Each bullet: title in bold-ish opening clause, one sentence on impact, one sentence on a credible mitigation. Skip risks rated LOW. No category-code prefixes.

sections.title: Priority recommendations
sections.purpose: 5–8 priority recommendations curated for the sponsor. Cluster by theme if helpful. Each bullet: action verb opener, the outcome it unlocks, and (where defensible) one phrase on effort relative to value. Do NOT paste the raw recommendations list — synthesise. No priority/domain prefixes.
